name: Varga
title: the Cage Rules Guest
blurb: Jeremy's Cage Rules guest. Four independent limbs, three held strike modifiers, stance switching and opponent-relative footwork. Read the Cage Rules controls below; this fighter uses a different layout.

comet_hook.name: Comet Hook
comet_hook.short: Hooks trail a gold shockwave arc that clips a second fighter
comet_hook.desc: Varga's hooks (Hooks + a hand) drag a comet tail of gold aura behind the fist: a 120-degree shockwave arc 2.3 metres deep that clips anyone beside or behind the fighter he hooks, even when the fist itself misses. Each Comet Hook costs 2.5 more stamina than a plain hook and recovers a moment later. Counterplay: the arc only goes forward; guard it, or step back out of its reach and punish the longer follow-through.

long_tail.name: Long Tail
long_tail.desc: A narrower arc (80 degrees) that reaches 3.2 metres, clipping fighters well behind the first.

heavy_comet.name: Heavy Comet
heavy_comet.desc: The arc hits half again as hard and staggers twice as much, but each Comet Hook costs 3 more stamina.

spiral_hook.name: Spiral Hook
spiral_hook.short: A spinning aura hook that drags the target in and turns him
spiral_hook.desc: Varga's hooks (Hooks + a hand) spin a gold vortex around the fist that drags fighters near it toward him. A clean hit pulls the target in and spins him 75 degrees, so his guard faces the wrong way for the next strike. It hits softer than a plain hook and costs 2 more stamina. Counterplay: a blocked Spiral Hook neither spins you nor pulls you far; keep the guard up and turn back to face him.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.desc: The vortex drags from 2 metres away, but spins the target only 30 degrees.

corkscrew.name: Corkscrew
corkscrew.desc: Spins the target right round (150 degrees) for an open back, at 2 more stamina.

pressure_palm.name: Pressure Palm
pressure_palm.short: Palm strikes throw a gold aura blast; hold the hand to charge it
pressure_palm.desc: Varga's straights (Straights + a hand) become palm strikes that throw a ball of gold aura at his target, about six metres. Tap for a quick palm and a small blast; hold the hand to gather aura (light hits don't stop him while he charges, up to 0.9 seconds) and let go to throw a blast up to three times as strong, twice the size and faster. Counterplay: the blast is a projectile: dodge through it, guard it or parry it with a timed guard tap, and rush him while he charges.

focused_palm.name: Focused Palm
focused_palm.desc: Charges twice as fast (0.45 s to full), but a full blast grows only half again its size.

great_aura.name: Great Aura
great_aura.desc: A full charge throws a huge, slower blast that passes through every fighter in its path.

force_palm.name: Force Palm
force_palm.short: A point-blank palm that blows fighters back and breaks guards
force_palm.desc: Varga's straights (Straights + a hand) become slower palm strikes that hit like heavies: a guard loses two and a half times the stamina (twice that again on the palm's contact), a guard already low on stamina breaks outright, and a clean hit sets off a point-blank aura burst that blows the target back. Counterplay: it winds up slower than a jab, so beat it to the punch, step out of its short reach, or grab him.

guard_breaker.name: Guard Breaker
guard_breaker.desc: Crushes a guard twice as hard again, but the burst does no damage (it still shoves).

palm_shove.name: Palm Shove
palm_shove.desc: The burst throws fighters twice as far, and one blown into the fence is splatted.

meteor_hammer.name: Meteor Hammer
meteor_hammer.short: An overhead that cracks the floor in a small shockwave ring
meteor_hammer.desc: Varga's overhands (Overhands + a hand) come down like a meteor: light hits don't stop the wind-up, and where the fist lands the floor cracks in a 1.25-metre ring that pops everyone in it off their feet for a moment. It is slower than a plain overhand and costs 3 more stamina. Counterplay: the wind-up is long; step out of the ring, or stop him with something heavier than a jab.

crater.name: Crater
crater.desc: A wider crack (1.8 m) that leaves broken floor for two seconds, slowing anyone else standing in it.

falling_star.name: Falling Star
falling_star.desc: The hammer itself knocks down on a clean hit, but the crack is smaller (0.9 m).

thunder_chop.name: Thunder Chop
thunder_chop.short: A fast overhead chop whose spark stuns
thunder_chop.desc: Varga's overhands (Overhands + a hand) become quick downward chops: faster than a plain overhand, with less reach and damage, and a clean hit crackles with a gold spark that stuns for 0.3 seconds longer, long enough to land the next strike of a string. Counterplay: it is short, so stay just outside his reach; a guard stops the spark entirely.

rolling_thunder.name: Rolling Thunder
rolling_thunder.desc: The spark jumps to a second fighter within two metres and stuns him too.

flash_chop.name: Flash Chop
flash_chop.desc: Another 10% faster and builds Rattled half again as fast, but the spark stuns half as long.

shockwave_kicks.name: Shockwave Kicks
shockwave_kicks.short: Kicks throw aura: a wave arc, a flying crescent and a tripping quake
shockwave_kicks.desc: Varga's kicks throw fighting aura. Body kick (Hooks + a leg): the Shockwave Roundhouse sends a 110-degree wave arc 2.5 metres out at body height. Head kick (Straights + a leg): the Crescent Moon Kick launches a crescent of aura that flies about six metres through every fighter in its path. Low kick (Overhands + a leg): the Sweep Quake shakes the floor where the kick lands and trips anyone standing there. The kicks themselves hit a little softer and cost more stamina. Counterplay: the waves only go forward: sidestep them, guard (a guard stops the trip), or parry the crescent.

wide_waves.name: Wide Waves
wide_waves.desc: The roundhouse arc covers 160 degrees, the crescent flies a third further and the quake spreads a third wider, but every wave hits 20% softer.

earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
earthshaker.desc: Every wave hits half again as hard and the quake trips from 1.5 metres, at 3 more stamina per kick.

iron_shins.name: Iron Shins
iron_shins.short: Armoured kicks: the Iron Shin, a knockdown Axe Kick and the slowing Leg Breaker
iron_shins.desc: Varga's shins turn to iron. Body kick (Hooks + a leg): the Iron Shin is armoured through its whole swing, so jabs and specials don't stop it (heavies still do). Head kick (Straights + a leg): the Axe Kick drops from above and knocks the target down. Low kick (Overhands + a leg): the Leg Breaker builds Rattled twice as fast and slows the target to three quarters speed for three seconds. Each kick costs a little more stamina. Counterplay: armour is not invulnerability: he still takes the damage, heavies and grabs stop him, and a guard stops the knockdown and the slow.

tempered_steel.name: Tempered Steel
tempered_steel.desc: All three kicks are armoured against everything but grabs, at 3 more stamina each.

bone_breaker.name: Bone Breaker
bone_breaker.desc: The Leg Breaker slows for five seconds and the Axe Kick builds Rattled twice as fast, but the Iron Shin loses its armour.
